meta.name: Generate employee numbers and ID cards with Google Sheets and Gmail

name: 02 - Onboarding - Employee ID and ID Card

parameters.content:
## 02 - Onboarding - Employee ID and ID Card

### How it works

This workflow is executed as part of employee onboarding to ensure an employee has an employee number and an ID card record. It looks up the employee in Google Sheets, generates and saves an employee number when needed, then either requests a missing photo or creates/updates the ID card record. When a photo is available, it renders a digital card, updates card status, routes the card through the configured print mode, and records the resulting event or failure.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials and ensure the employee, ID card, task/event, and configuration sheets have the columns referenced by the workflow.
- Configure Gmail credentials for the photo request email step.
- Set the environment variable ID_CARD_RENDERER_URL to the card rendering service endpoint.
- Set the environment variable PRINT_VENDOR_URL if using the mock/vendor print job path.
- Populate the print mode configuration in Google Sheets so the Switch node can route to vendor print, GA task, or digital-only activation.

### Customization

Adjust employee number generation rules, card ID/token validity, photo request email text, print-mode values, and the render payload fields to match local HR and card production processes.

## Start employee lookup

Receives the sub-workflow execution request and retrieves the matching employee row from Google Sheets.

## Generate employee number

Checks whether an employee number already exists, generates one when missing, and searches Google Sheets for possible number collisions.

## Resolve number collision

Combines generated employee data with the collision check result, branches on collision status, and saves the employee number when it is safe to use.

## Route by photo

Determines whether the employee has an available photo and starts either the card lookup path or the waiting-for-photo update path.

## Request missing photo

Creates a photo request task, emails the employee or responsible party, and ends the missing-photo branch cleanly.

## Prepare card metadata

Merges employee and existing card information, generates a verification token, builds card metadata, and decides whether to append or update the card record.

## Upsert card record

Appends a new ID card row or updates an existing one, then prepares the payload needed by the rendering service.

## Render card image

Sends the render payload to the ID card renderer and checks whether rendering completed successfully.

## Save render result

Maps the successful render response and updates the ID card file URL and status in Google Sheets.

## Choose print mode

Reads print mode configuration from Google Sheets and routes the workflow to vendor printing, a GA print task, or digital-only activation.

## Vendor print job

Sends the card to the configured print vendor endpoint, captures the print reference, and saves it back to the card record.

## GA print task

Creates a GA/internal print task, stores the generated task reference, and updates the ID card print reference.

## Digital card activation

Marks the rendered card as digitally active and updates the card status in Google Sheets without creating a print job.

## Append card event

Records the final ID card event after any print or digital-only route completes.

## Failure logging and stop

Updates card failure status, appends a render failure event, and stops the workflow with an error; the same stop node also handles employee number collision failures.

value.employee_no: ={{ $('Update Employee Number in Sheets')?.item?.json?.employee_no || $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.employee_no }}

nodes.name: Update Existing ID Card in Sheets

assignments.name: render_payload
assignments.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({template:'employee-id-card-v1', employee_no: ($('Update Employee Number in Sheets')?.item?.json?.employee_no || $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.employee_no), full_name: $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.full_name, job_title: $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.job_title, department: $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.department, photo_url: $('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.photo_url, valid_until: $json.valid_until, verification_url: ($env.ID_CARD_VERIFY_BASE_URL + '/' + $json.verification_token), output:'pdf'}) }}

assignments.name: card_id
assignments.value: ={{ $('Append New ID Card to Sheets').item.json.card_id || $('Update Existing ID Card in Sheets').item.json.card_id }}

assignments.name: due_date
assignments.value: ={{ new Date(new Date($('Find Employee in Sheets').item.json.start_date + 'T00:00:00Z').getTime() - 3*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10) }}
